name: Admin Accounting Statistics Surfaces
description: Superuser opens descriptive-statistics surfaces from the accounting Resumen. Ingresos líquidos, Gastos {year} and Deuda tarjetas remain clickable cards that open StatsModal (BaseModal 5xl + BaseTabs) with their tabbed ApexCharts views. Utility statistics no longer use an icon or modal: evolution, margins and partner distribution are embedded inside the Utilidad líquida hero as a default-open accordion. Income/expense tabs feed from GET /api/accounting/stats/?year= (lazy, cached per year in the accounting store and reset on year change); utility/cards views compute client-side from the dashboard summary and card snapshots.
